hunks.baseline: Unlike his violently pounding heart, his mind was ice-cold.
hunks.sol: His heart pounded wildly, but his mind was ice-cold.

hunks.baseline: Only thirty minutes had passed since the battle began. The hastily constructed defensive line had collapsed the moment the fighting started, and when the highest-grade monsters slipped through the gaps and began rampaging as if no one stood in their way, it had been torn apart completely.
hunks.sol: Only thirty minutes had passed since the battle began. The hastily constructed defensive line had collapsed the instant the fighting started, then been torn apart as the highest-grade monsters slipped through the gaps and ran rampant without meeting any resistance.

hunks.baseline: Sharp fangs savagely bit into a human throat.
hunks.sol: Sharp fangs tore savagely into a human throat.

hunks.baseline: The Lycanthrope threw aside the Hunter it had killed with a wheezing exhalation and let out a roar.
hunks.sol: The Lycanthrope tossed aside the Hunter, whose last breath escaped in a wheeze, and let out a roar.

hunks.baseline: —Awooooooooo!
hunks.sol: —Awooooooo!

hunks.baseline: And those became the Lycanthrope’s final words.
hunks.sol: Those became the Lycanthrope’s final words.

hunks.baseline: Whoosh. Slash!
hunks.sol: Whoosh! Slash!

hunks.baseline: Gray fur was dyed red, and its body tilted. Choi Minwoo decapitated it with a clean, waste-free strike, then bent backward without even a moment to catch his breath.
hunks.sol: Its gray fur turned red as its body toppled sideways. Choi Minwoo took its head off with a clean strike, then bent backward without a moment to catch his breath.

hunks.baseline: It had passed within a handspan.
hunks.sol: The blow missed him by a handspan.

hunks.baseline: An ax blade rippling with ominous magic grazed Choi Minwoo and smashed the heads of two Orcs nearby.
hunks.sol: An ax blade rippling with ominous magic grazed past Choi Minwoo and smashed the heads of two nearby Orcs.

hunks.baseline: The headless knight, a Dullahan, attacked the human in front of it without the slightest hesitation, despite having killed one of its own kind.
hunks.sol: The headless knight—a Dullahan—continued its assault on the human before it without the slightest hesitation, despite having killed its own allies.

hunks.baseline: As the enormous halberd swept back and forth, the bodies of humans and monsters caught within its range were torn apart.
hunks.sol: As the enormous halberd swept back and forth, the humans and monsters caught within its reach were hacked to pieces.

hunks.baseline: A Dullahan was an A-rank monster that required three Hunters of the same level to deal with safely.
hunks.sol: A Dullahan was an A-rank monster that required three Hunters of the same rank to handle safely.

hunks.baseline: But Choi Minwoo slipped past its attack like water and thrust out his sword without hesitation.
hunks.sol: But Choi Minwoo slipped past its attack and thrust out his sword without hesitation.

hunks.baseline: A short exhalation.
hunks.sol: A sharp exhalation.

hunks.baseline: Then a strike as swift as a flash of light.
hunks.sol: Then a strike like a flash of light.

hunks.baseline: The blade, enchanted with three different spells and forged by a Master Artisan, pierced through the Dullahan’s shoulder.
hunks.sol: The blade, enchanted with three different spells and forged by a Master Artisan, pierced the Dullahan through the shoulder.

hunks.baseline: It had already died once and become undead, so it might not have felt pain. But its body was still human.
hunks.sol: It might not feel pain, having already died once and become undead, but its body was still human.

hunks.baseline: When the muscles and tendons of its right arm were severed, the halberd lost its strength and slammed into the ground. Choi Minwoo did not miss the opening.
hunks.sol: The muscles and tendons in its right arm were severed, and the halberd dropped heavily to the ground. Choi Minwoo did not miss the opening.

hunks.baseline: A blade of white aura cleaved the Dullahan in half at the waist. It must have died only recently, because rotten blood burst from its collapsing body and splattered across Choi Minwoo’s face.
hunks.sol: A white blade of aura cleaved the Dullahan in half at the waist. It must not have been dead for long, because rotten blood sprayed from its collapsing body and splattered across Choi Minwoo’s face.

hunks.baseline: But even in the face of the terrible stench stabbing at his nose, he did not so much as twitch an eyebrow.
hunks.sol: But despite the overpowering stench stabbing at his nose, he did not so much as twitch an eyebrow.

hunks.baseline: Choi Minwoo was consumed by the tension of the battlefield, his cold reason, and a faint exhilaration.
hunks.sol: Choi Minwoo was gripped by the tension of the battlefield, cold reason, and a faint exhilaration.

hunks.baseline: The number of A-rank monsters Choi Minwoo had defeated alone today. Including the monsters of lower grades, the number must have easily exceeded fifty.
hunks.sol: That was how many A-rank monsters Choi Minwoo had defeated by himself today. Including those of lower grades, the number had to be well over fifty.

hunks.baseline: Even so, Choi Minwoo had been able to perform so well in this chaotic battle because he had been blessed with two strokes of luck.
hunks.sol: Even so, Choi Minwoo had been able to distinguish himself in such a chaotic battle because he had been blessed with two strokes of luck.

hunks.baseline: Choi Minwoo had been suspicious of Jin Taekyung’s claim that it was a family heirloom passed down through the generations. But he had no disagreement whatsoever that it was an outstanding secret technique.
hunks.sol: Choi Minwoo had his doubts about Jin Taekyung’s claim that it was a family heirloom passed down through generations. But he had no doubt whatsoever that it was an outstanding secret technique.

hunks.baseline: The Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique he had learned allowed him to control his energy steadily while greatly improving his distribution of strength. The immense mana he had gained during his training had also given him stamina that let him fight without tiring easily.
hunks.sol: The Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique allowed him to control his energy reliably while greatly improving how he distributed his strength. The immense mana he had gained while learning it also gave him the stamina to keep fighting without tiring easily.

hunks.baseline: A rebar swung with berserk force smashed through the concrete road.
hunks.sol: A length of rebar swung with berserk force and smashed through the concrete road.

hunks.baseline: Choi Minwoo sprang upward, stepping on the ogre’s thick arm, and brought his sword down with all his strength.
hunks.sol: Choi Minwoo stepped on the ogre’s thick arm and sprang upward, bringing his sword down with all his strength.

hunks.baseline: The aura-infused blade split through the ogre’s crown as easily as tofu.
hunks.sol: The aura-infused blade split the ogre’s crown as easily as tofu.

hunks.baseline: The four-meter-tall giant dropped to its knees with a heavy crash. Choi Minwoo stood atop the shoulder of the dead creature and swept his gaze rapidly across his surroundings.
hunks.sol: The four-meter giant dropped to its knees with a heavy crash. Standing on the dead creature’s shoulder, Choi Minwoo quickly swept his gaze over his surroundings.

hunks.baseline: A hellish scene overflowed with screams and death on every side.
hunks.sol: Screams and death filled the hellish scene on every side.

hunks.baseline: Choi Minwoo remembered the black knight clearly. With a single strike, it had swept aside dozens of Hunters.
hunks.sol: Choi Minwoo clearly remembered the black knight sweeping aside dozens of Hunters with a single blow.

hunks.baseline: If the creature had truly decided to join the battle, the humans might have been annihilated without lasting even thirty minutes.
hunks.sol: If the creature had truly committed itself to the battle, the humans might have been annihilated before they lasted even thirty minutes.

hunks.baseline: But for some reason, the black knight had not appeared since then.
hunks.sol: But for some reason, the black knight had not appeared again.

hunks.baseline: Was it the monster’s arrogance—the belief that this was not a battle worthy of its intervention?
hunks.sol: Was it the monster’s arrogance? Did it consider the battle too insignificant to warrant its involvement?

hunks.baseline: Choi Minwoo could not understand it at all. But that was both the second stroke of luck he had been granted and his last chance to make a decision.
hunks.sol: Choi Minwoo could not understand it. But the black knight’s absence was both his second stroke of luck and his final chance to make a decision.

hunks.baseline: The urban battle had already lost all meaning. The monster army, numbering around ten thousand, had already covered the city like a swarm of ants. Among them were more than a hundred A-rank monsters.
hunks.sol: The battle for the city was already lost. The monster army, numbering around ten thousand, had covered the city like a swarm of ants. Among them were roughly a hundred A-rank monsters.

hunks.baseline: They were outmatched in both numbers and strength.
hunks.sol: The humans were outmatched in both numbers and strength.

hunks.baseline: Nearly half of the thousand Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces Department who had been holding the front line were already dead or wounded. And more than half of the damned People’s Liberation Army had thrown down their weapons and fled before the monsters even approached.
hunks.sol: Nearly half of the thousand Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces Department who had held the front line were already dead or wounded. And more than half of the damned People’s Liberation Army had thrown down their weapons and fled before the monsters even reached them.

hunks.baseline: The armored units, reduced to heaps of scrap metal, and the air force, becoming prey for the flying monsters, were simply more of the same.
hunks.sol: The armored units had been reduced to heaps of scrap metal, and the air force was rapidly becoming prey for the flying monsters.

hunks.baseline: A state-of-the-art combat helicopter lost its balance and plunged from the sky, exploding in flames. Around a dozen soldiers caught in the flying debris died without even having time to scream.
hunks.sol: A state-of-the-art combat helicopter lost control and plunged from the sky, exploding in flames. Around a dozen soldiers caught in the flying debris died before they could even scream.

hunks.baseline: It was a horrifying sight. But in terms of dying without pain, they were the lucky ones.
hunks.sol: It was a horrifying sight, but they were fortunate in one respect: their deaths had been painless.

hunks.baseline: The monster horde began tearing everyone apart indiscriminately.
hunks.sol: A moment later, the monster horde began tearing everyone else apart indiscriminately.

hunks.baseline: The foreleg of a Saber Tiger, carrying several tons of force, crushed a soldier’s limbs and burst his head.
hunks.sol: A Saber Tiger’s forepaw came down with several tons of force, crushing limbs and bursting heads.

hunks.baseline: The soldiers of the People’s Liberation Army were not as fast as Hunters, and the rifles they carried were no different from slingshots to the monsters.
hunks.sol: The soldiers of the People’s Liberation Army were nowhere near as fast as Hunters, and the rifles they carried were little better than slingshots against the monsters.

hunks.baseline: *Pull yourself together. You can’t save all of them.*
hunks.sol: *Get a grip. You can’t save all of them.*

hunks.baseline: He did not speak hypocritically of sacrificing the few for the sake of the many. He simply faced the situation with a cold eye and finished preparing himself to become the villain of this stage.
hunks.sol: He did not hypocritically preach about sacrificing the few for the many. He simply faced the situation with a cold eye and prepared himself to play the villain.

hunks.baseline: *Could we have stopped them if he had come?*
hunks.sol: *Could we have stopped them if he’d come?*

hunks.baseline: He suddenly thought of Jin Taekyung, but it was nothing more than useless regret.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung suddenly came to mind, but that was nothing more than futile regret.

hunks.baseline: Even after hounding the communications officer into sending emergency signals frantically, there had been no response.
hunks.sol: Even after he hounded the communications officer into frantically transmitting emergency signals, there had been no response.

hunks.baseline: A carefully planned ambush, combined with thorough communications interference.
hunks.sol: A carefully planned surprise attack combined with thorough communications interference.

hunks.baseline: For now, all he could do was hope that one of the countless glass bottles cast into the sea would somehow reach him.
hunks.sol: For now, all he could do was hope that one of the countless glass bottles cast into the sea would somehow reach Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: His mana-infused voice pierced through the screams and thunderous crashes and reached one person’s ears.
hunks.sol: His mana-infused voice pierced the screams and thunderous crashes to reach its intended target.

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen, covered in wounds and blood as he fought back the endless stream of monsters, shouted in response like a battle cry.
hunks.sol: Covered in wounds and blood as he fought back the endless stream of monsters, Shao Shen answered with a battle cry.

hunks.baseline: 「Speak!」
hunks.sol: “Speak!”

hunks.baseline: 「What? But if we retreat now…」
hunks.sol: “What? But if we retreat now…”

hunks.baseline: The greatest number of casualties occurred during the pursuit after a retreat.
hunks.sol: Retreats—and the pursuits that followed—were when the greatest number of casualties occurred.

hunks.baseline: Especially in a situation like this, if the Hunters who had been serving as the last barrier withdrew, the People’s Liberation Army would fall into the monster army’s grasp.
hunks.sol: Especially in a situation like this. If the Hunters serving as the last line of defense withdrew, the People’s Liberation Army would fall straight into the monster army’s grasp.

hunks.baseline: “If we get surrounded, it’s all over. Do you understand? Even now, you need to lead the surviving Hunters and the rear units out of the city!”
hunks.sol: “If we’re surrounded, it’s all over. Do you understand? Take the surviving Hunters and the rear units and get out of the city while you still can!”

hunks.baseline: 「……Mr. Choi.」
hunks.sol: “……Mr. Choi.”

hunks.baseline: He knew the situation. No—he was one of the people who understood it better than anyone.
hunks.sol: He knew what the situation was. No—he understood it better than almost anyone.

hunks.baseline: The battle had turned sharply against them from the very beginning, and the humans had been driven all the way back to the hospital they were using as a temporary command center. If the monsters completed their encirclement—
hunks.sol: The tide had turned sharply against them from the moment the battle began, and the humans had been driven all the way back to the hospital they were using as a temporary command center. If the monsters completed their encirclement—

hunks.baseline: He had thought for a long time, but the moment itself was brief.
hunks.sol: His deliberation felt long, but only a moment passed.

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen opened his eyes and shouted with all his strength while deflecting the attacks raining down on him.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen opened his eyes and shouted with all his strength as he deflected the attacks raining down on him.

hunks.baseline: 「Retreat! All Public Security Armed Forces Department personnel, withdraw immediately! The North Gate is open!」
hunks.sol: “Retreat! All Public Security Armed Forces Department personnel, withdraw immediately! The North Gate is open!”

hunks.baseline: During wartime, the command of a commander like Shao Shen was absolute.
hunks.sol: In wartime, the orders of a commander like Shao Shen were absolute.

hunks.baseline: The soldiers might not have much hope, but the Hunters’ odds of survival would rise dramatically. If Shao Shen made the right calls, a considerable number of them might be able to break through the encirclement and survive.
hunks.sol: The soldiers might not have much hope, but the Hunters’ odds of survival would rise dramatically. If Shao Shen made the right calls, many of them might break through the encirclement and survive.

hunks.baseline: Feeling his heart grow lighter, Choi Minwoo threw himself forward.
hunks.sol: Feeling his heart grow lighter, Choi Minwoo launched himself forward.

hunks.baseline: *It feels like I’m going to kill myself.*
hunks.sol: *It feels like I’m going to my own death.*

hunks.baseline: For something that amounted to going to his death, he felt surprisingly good.
hunks.sol: For a man heading to his death, he felt surprisingly good.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps because dark clouds had gathered overhead, the wind was cool. And behind him, he had companions who would die alongside him, so he would not have to die alone.
hunks.sol: Perhaps it was because dark clouds had gathered overhead, cooling the wind. Or perhaps it was because he had companions behind him who would die alongside him, so he would not have to die alone.

hunks.baseline: Choi Minwoo suddenly parted his lips.
hunks.sol: Choi Minwoo suddenly spoke.

hunks.baseline: 「What about you, Mr. Choi?」
hunks.sol: “What about you, Mr. Choi?”

hunks.baseline: 「Then I suppose I should answer first. Public Security Armed Forces Department!」
hunks.sol: “Then I suppose I should answer first. Public Security Armed Forces Department!”

hunks.baseline: At the regimental commander’s call, the roughly three hundred Hunters following behind him released a thunderous shout.
hunks.sol: At the regimental commander’s call, the roughly three hundred Hunters following behind him let out a thunderous shout.

hunks.baseline: 「To eliminate monsters and protect the people from every threat!」
hunks.sol: “To eliminate monsters and protect the people from every threat!”

hunks.baseline: 「This is why we do not retreat. The 325 members of the Sichuan Province Public Security Armed Forces Department’s 1st Regiment, led by Regimental Commander Shao Shen, have come to protect the people!」
hunks.sol: “This is why we do not retreat. Regimental Commander Shao Shen and all 325 members of the Sichuan Province Public Security Armed Forces Department’s 1st Regiment are here to protect the people!”

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen’s quiet voice followed.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen continued in a quiet voice.

hunks.baseline: 「Now it is your turn to answer, Mr. Choi.」
hunks.sol: “Now it’s your turn to answer, Mr. Choi.”

hunks.baseline: Choi Minwoo silently gazed at the thousands of monsters drawing closer, then suddenly muttered,
hunks.sol: Choi Minwoo silently watched the thousands of monsters drawing closer, then abruptly said,

hunks.baseline: “Fuck. Quite a crowd.”
hunks.sol: “Shit. There sure are a lot of them.”

hunks.baseline: “That man probably would have said something like that. And he would have fought harder than anyone else, then won in the end.”
hunks.sol: “That’s probably what he would have said. Then he would have fought harder than anyone else and won in the end.”

hunks.baseline: He had never retreated from any situation and had never given up. Choi Minwoo, who had watched him from closer and for longer than anyone else, knew that.
hunks.sol: He had never backed down, no matter the situation, and he had never given up. Choi Minwoo had watched him longer and more closely than anyone else, so he knew.

hunks.baseline: That man, Jin Taekyung, was a hero of the new age, while Choi Minwoo could never create miracles the way he did.
hunks.sol: That man, Jin Taekyung, was a hero of the new age. Choi Minwoo could never work miracles the way he did.

hunks.baseline: “It’s embarrassing.”
hunks.sol: “It’d be humiliating.”

hunks.baseline: 「What?」
hunks.sol: “What?”

hunks.baseline: “Jin Taekyung is technically my subordinate, you see. This is when a superior should lead by example.”
hunks.sol: “Jin Taekyung is technically my subordinate, you see. At a time like this, his superior ought to lead by example.”

hunks.baseline: His heart felt as light as a dandelion seed, and an indescribable power surged through his body as he launched himself toward the enemies.
hunks.sol: His heart felt as light as a dandelion seed, and an unfamiliar power unlike anything he had ever felt before surged through his body as he shot toward the enemy.

hunks.baseline: The blade of his sword, filled with aura brighter and more radiant than ever, pointed toward the enemies.
hunks.sol: The blade of his sword, filled with an aura brighter and more radiant than ever, pointed toward the enemy.

hunks.baseline: The roughly three hundred-strong death squad, roaring loud enough to deafen the ears and overflowing with fighting spirit, shot forward behind him like arrows.
hunks.sol: The suicide squad of more than three hundred Hunters roared loud enough to deafen the ears, their fighting spirit surging as they shot forward behind him like arrows.

hunks.baseline: “Waaaaaaaah!”
hunks.sol: “Waaaaaaaaah!”

hunks.baseline: Two Death Knights who had been leading thousands of monsters and slaughtering the People’s Liberation Army looked down from their skeletal warhorses at the pitiful human force.
hunks.sol: Two Death Knights who had been leading thousands of monsters in the slaughter of the People’s Liberation Army looked down from their skeletal warhorses at the pitiful human force.

hunks.baseline: A moment later, the black wave swallowed the white pebbles.
hunks.sol: A moment later, the black wave swallowed the single white pebble.

hunks.baseline: The battle’s conclusion had already been decided. Yet at the end of the fiercest battle of all, there was a sword belonging to someone whose light had never faded from beginning to end.
hunks.sol: The outcome had been decided from the beginning. Yet at the end of that battle, more fiercely fought than any before it, one man’s sword had never lost its light.

hunks.baseline: It had gone as expected. The humans had been unable to stop his mighty army and had collapsed all at once.
hunks.sol: It had gone as expected. The humans had been unable to stop his mighty legion and had collapsed in a single stroke.

hunks.baseline: But if someone asked whether everything had unfolded according to the black knight’s wishes, the answer would have been no.
hunks.sol: But if asked whether everything had unfolded according to the black knight’s wishes, the answer would have been no.

hunks.baseline: *Those humans from back then.*
hunks.sol: *Those humans from before.*

hunks.baseline: After breaking through the city and forcing the humans to retreat at the start of the battle, the black knight had casually turned his warhorse around.
hunks.sol: After breaking through the city and forcing the humans to retreat at the start of the battle, the black knight had turned his warhorse wherever the whim took him.

hunks.baseline: And at the previous day’s location—a place that felt strangely familiar—he had found something small.
hunks.sol: For some reason, he had returned to the strangely familiar place from the previous day, where he found something small.

hunks.baseline: As the black knight had thought, it was a child’s shoe. A tiny infant’s shoe left behind during the chaos, without anyone realizing it had been dropped.
hunks.sol: As the black knight had thought, it was a child’s shoe—a tiny infant’s shoe lost in the chaos and left behind without anyone realizing it had fallen.

hunks.baseline: Looking at the unbelievably small, dirt-covered shoe, he felt that it was strangely familiar. His chest hurt.
hunks.sol: The infinitely small, dirt-covered shoe seemed strangely familiar. Looking at it made his chest ache.

hunks.baseline: *Hm? My chest hurts?*
hunks.sol: *Hm? My chest aches?*

hunks.baseline: The black knight’s body had been incapable of feeling pain from the beginning. His master had created him personally and given him a powerful blessing. Naturally, he did not tire, nor did he feel pain.
hunks.sol: The black knight’s body had been incapable of feeling pain from the beginning. His master had personally created him and bestowed a powerful blessing upon him. Naturally, he never tired and felt no pain.

hunks.baseline: The black knight tucked the shoe he held into a gap between the plates of his armor and changed the subject.
hunks.sol: The black knight tucked the shoe into a gap in his armor and changed the subject.

hunks.baseline: —No. Rather, quite a few humans managed to escape alive.
hunks.sol: —No. More importantly, quite a few humans escaped alive.

hunks.baseline: As if they had been waiting for those words, the densely packed monsters parted left and right, opening a path.
hunks.sol: As if they had been waiting for those words, the densely packed monsters parted left and right to open a path.

hunks.baseline: A Troll cautiously approached, lowered what it had been carrying across its shoulders, and stepped back.
hunks.sol: A Troll approached cautiously, lowered the two figures slung over its shoulders, and stepped back.

hunks.baseline: The black knight’s eyes shimmered as he looked at the “small prize.”
hunks.sol: The black knight’s eyes flickered as he regarded the “small prize.”

hunks.baseline: The two loyal retainers answered at the same time, then continued.
hunks.sol: The two loyal retainers answered in unison, then continued.

hunks.baseline: —Personally reap their souls—
hunks.sol: —Reap their souls yourself—

hunks.baseline: They were right. Those two humans possessed rich and desirable souls.
hunks.sol: They were right. Those two humans possessed rich, enticing souls.

hunks.baseline: If he personally reaped them and made them his subordinates, they would be reborn as even more outstanding warriors. They might even be entrusted with command over an entire force.
hunks.sol: If he personally reaped their souls and took them as subordinates, they would be reborn as even greater warriors. They might even prove worthy of commanding an entire force.

hunks.baseline: This was something he obviously had to do. Gaining powerful subordinates would strengthen the legion, which in turn meant loyalty and devotion to the King of Death whom he served.
hunks.sol: This was obviously something he had to do. Powerful subordinates would strengthen the legion, and strengthening the legion was an act of loyalty and devotion to the King of Death he served.

hunks.baseline: Under normal circumstances, he would have withdrawn, feeling that something was wrong. But recently, the black knight had experienced this kind of confusion far too many times.
hunks.sol: Ordinarily, he would have held back if something felt wrong. But the black knight had experienced this same confusion far too often of late.

hunks.baseline: The fact that he had forced himself to reach out might have been an act of defiance against himself.
hunks.sol: Perhaps forcing himself to reach out was an act of defiance against his own hesitation.

hunks.baseline: And the moment the black knight’s hand reached out to reap the souls of the two humans—
hunks.sol: Then, just as the black knight reached toward the two humans to reap their souls—

hunks.baseline: “I’ve been thinking about it carefully.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve given it some thought.”

hunks.baseline: On the roof of the half-burned, half-collapsed hospital, someone stood with the sunlight shining through the dark clouds behind him.
hunks.sol: Someone stood atop the half-burned, half-collapsed hospital, framed by sunlight streaming through the dark clouds behind him.

hunks.baseline: “Ten percent is surprisingly high when you think about it. Hmm. It’s definitely higher than my chances of getting a girlfriend.”
hunks.sol: “Ten percent is surprisingly high when you think about it. Hmm. Definitely higher than my chances of getting a girlfriend.”

hunks.baseline: The black knight’s eyes narrowed. It was the same energy he had sensed from afar the day before.
hunks.sol: The black knight’s eyes narrowed. He recognized that energy. He had sensed it from afar the previous day.

hunks.baseline: It happened in an instant. A young human dropped rapidly from a dizzying height, yet landed as lightly as a leaf. Pointing at himself with one finger, he grinned.
hunks.sol: It happened in an instant. The young human dropped rapidly from a dizzying height, yet landed as lightly as a leaf. He pointed to himself with one finger and grinned.

hunks.baseline: “I’m a son of a bitch who’s disgustingly lucky.”
hunks.sol: “I’m one damn lucky bastard.”

hunks.baseline: The human’s finger moving toward him.
hunks.sol: The human’s finger shifting to point at him.

hunks.baseline: And the expression on the human’s face, from which every emotion had vanished.
hunks.sol: And every trace of emotion vanishing from the human’s face.

hunks.baseline: “You’re, what…”
hunks.sol: “You, on the other hand…”

hunks.baseline: A voice cold enough to make even the dead shudder continued.
hunks.sol: His voice was cold enough to make even the dead shudder.

hunks.baseline: “You’re a son of a bitch who’s disgustingly unlucky.”
hunks.sol: “You’re one damn unlucky bastard.”
